_comment: Build-time switches. practice_quality_live=false hides the hexagon hero moment, the How-it-went section and the table row until the app feature ships. android_early_access=false keeps the /android form out of the page (the page is unlinked, noindex and not in the sitemap either way); the founder has not approved APK distribution. Before turning it on, add the Supabase host to connect-src in _headers. new_demo_video=false leaves the demo film section out of the home page (no film, no anchor) until the founder approves the new per-language films in media/demo/.
